d.title: Welcome bonus 188%
d.summary: First deposit only, bonus capped by tier.
d.rules:
## How this bonus works

Placeholder terms. The operator credits the bonus after the first qualifying deposit clears.

### Qualifying deposits

- Minimum deposit: RM 50
- One claim per account, first deposit only
- Wallet credit appears within 5 minutes

### Turnover

| Product | Contribution |
| --- | --- |
| Slots | 100% |
| Live casino | 20% |
| Sports | 15% |
| 4D | Not counted |

### What voids the bonus

Casino table games do not contribute. Stakes placed on both sides of one market do not count.

### Claiming

Open the Voucher (Promo Code) dialog and enter the code from your inbox message.

d.title: Daily reload 18%
d.summary: One claim per day, minimum deposit RM 50.
d.rules:
## Daily reload

Placeholder terms for the daily reload offer.

- One claim per day, per account
- Minimum deposit RM 50, maximum bonus RM 88
- Turnover 5x before withdrawal

### Notes

The bonus expires 7 days after it is credited. Unused bonus balance is removed at that point.

d.title: Slots rebate 0.8%
d.summary: Daily rebate on slots turnover, no cap, no turnover requirement.
d.rules:
## Slots rebate

Placeholder terms. A share of slots turnover returns as cash rebate.

- Credited daily at 04:00 (+08:00)
- No cap and no turnover requirement
- Claim from Rebates in the member area

### Exclusions

Rebate does not apply to bonus money, jackpot contributions or voided bets.

d.title: Live casino weekend 28%
d.summary: Friday to Sunday, live tables only.
d.rules:
## Live casino weekend

Placeholder terms for the weekend offer.

- Runs Friday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 (+08:00)
- Live tables only; slots and sports do not count
- Turnover 6x within 14 days

### Table limits

Bets below RM 1 and above RM 500 per hand do not contribute to turnover.

d.title: Sports cashback 5%
d.summary: Weekly cashback on net losses, pre-match and live.
d.rules:
## Sports cashback

Placeholder terms.

- Calculated on net losses for the week
- Paid every Tuesday before 12:00 (+08:00)
- Turnover 1x before withdrawal

### Exclusions

Voided, cancelled and cashed-out bets are excluded. Minimum qualifying weekly turnover is RM 200.

d.rules:

Placeholder terms.

- 150 spins, credited in batches of 50
- Spin value RM 0.20
- Winnings are bonus money with 20x turnover

### Selected slot

The slot is announced in the inbox each Monday at 09:00 (+08:00).

d.title: Refer a friend, get RM 88
d.summary: Both sides are credited after the friend's first deposit.
d.rules:
## Referral programme

Placeholder terms.

- Share your referral code from the member area
- The friend must deposit at least RM 50
- Both accounts receive RM 88

### Limits

Up to 10 successful referrals per account each month. Self-referral and duplicate devices are excluded.
